name: @tdcp/channel-guardian
description: Channel Guardian for TDCP — egress protection with Authority-signed policy binding. Protects the communication channel between sensitive data and encryption/authorization processes. Does not issue grants or evaluate business policy.

scripts.test: node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --passWithNoTests 2>/dev/null || node --test test/*.test.js 2>/dev/null || echo 'Run: npm run build && node --test test/'
